description: Cross-family alignment of the C. albicans MNT-named proteins against S. cerevisiae GT71 paralogs and Kre2, showing the gene-name collision
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---- Figure: cross-family alignment scores computed in the previous cell -------------
df = pd.read_csv("calbicans_vs_sc_gt71_alignment.csv")
order = ["MNN1","MNT2","MNT3","MNT4","MNN2","MNN5","ScKRE2 (P27809, PF01793)"]
lab   = ["ScMnn1","ScMnt2","ScMnt3","ScMnt4","ScMnn2","ScMnn5","ScKre2\n(GT15)"]
q4 = df[df["query"].str.startswith("CaMNT4")].set_index("Sc_paralog").loc[order]
q3 = df[df["query"].str.startswith("CaMNT3")].set_index("Sc_paralog").loc[order]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.2))
x = np.arange(len(order)); w = 0.38
ax[0].bar(x-w/2, q4["score"], w, color="#2b6cb0", label="CaMnt4 (Q59MZ9, GT71)")
ax[0].bar(x+w/2, q3["score"], w, color="#c05621", label="CaMnt3 (P87207, GT15)")
ax[0].axhline(0, color="k", lw=0.8)
ax[0].set_xticks(x); ax[0].set_xticklabels(lab, fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_ylabel("global alignment score (BLOSUM62, -11/-1)")
ax[0].set_title("C. albicans MNT-named proteins vs S. cerevisiae references", fontsize=9)
ax[0].legend(fontsize=7.5)

ax[1].bar(x-w/2, q4["pid"], w, color="#2b6cb0")
ax[1].bar(x+w/2, q3["pid"], w, color="#c05621")
ax[1].set_xticks(x); ax[1].set_xticklabels(lab, fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_ylabel("percent identity")
ax[1].set_title("Percent identity over the aligned region", fontsize=9)
for s in ("top","right"):
    ax[0].spines[s].set_visible(False); ax[1].spines[s].set_visible(False)
fig.suptitle("The MNT4 name collision: CaMnt3 is a Kre2 (GT15) protein, CaMnt4 is GT71 but not a confident ScMnt4 ortholog", fontsize=9.5)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
